title: FileDiffInfo
description: The unified diff for one file, or an explanation of why there is not one. The kind is always present, so every awkward case — no diff, binary, oversized — is one branch rather than a null check.

kind.description: text when unifiedDiff is present; binary when git will not diff the content; absent when the file did not change; too_large when the diff exceeds the size the host will send.

path.description: Repository-relative path the diff is for.

previousPath.description: Where the file came from, for a rename or a copy.

unifiedDiff.description: Unified diff text including the diff --git header. Present only when kind is text.

sizeBytes.description: Size of the diff in bytes, or of the file when there is no diff to show. Always the true size, even when the content was withheld for being too large.
